tooltip.another_dynamics.guide.line0: In-game handbook for ducts and machines.
item.another_dynamics.settings_copier.to: Used to copy settings onto duct nodes or filter lists.
Insert it in the Copy slot and click Copy!
Insert it in the Copy slot and click Paste to configure a node.
Or Shift+right-click a duct node face.
Insert it in the Copy slot and click Copy to overwrite with new settings.
Place in a crafting grid to reset completely.
Insert it in the Copy slot and click Paste to apply a filter list.
Insert it in the Copy slot and click Copy to overwrite with new settings.
Place in a crafting grid to reset completely.
Sequential mode: hold this while opening a Sequential Buffer, then click C to copy.
Shift+right-click a Sequential Buffer to paste stored Sequence Lists.
Shift+right-click a Sequential Buffer to paste Sequence Lists.
Or open the buffer GUI and click P while holding this copier.
Place in a crafting grid to reset completely.
Right-click (air or block) to open the settings editor.
gui.another_dynamics.settings_copier.con: Open the virtual editor to set up what this copier will store and paste.
gui.another_dynamics.settings_copier.mod: Stores full face/node settings (Whole Duct). Click again to change mode (clears stored data).
Stores a filter list only. Click again to change mode (clears stored data).
Stores Sequential Buffer Sequence Lists. Click again to change mode (clears stored data).
Stores whole-duct settings (e.g. Pipez import). Click again to change mode (clears stored data).
Confirm: change mode and clear all stored data. Right-click or Esc to cancel.
gui.another_dynamics.settings_copier.ren: Apply the custom name typed above.
Custom display name for this Settings Copier. Right-click to clear.
gui.another_dynamics.settings_copier.imp: Import filter lists from a compatible item (Pipez filter modules).
Requires the Pipez mod to import filter lists.
message.another_dynamics.filter_import.n: No compatible filter source on this item
message.another_dynamics.filter_import.e: No filters to import on this channel
message.another_dynamics.filter_import.m: Place a second settings copier for inverted filters
message.another_dynamics.settings_copier: Copier filter type is not set
Cannot paste %s filters on this duct face
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.settings_: Copy settings from this GUI into the copier
Paste settings from the copier into this GUI
Set filter type in the copier editor first
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.deny_list: Open deny filters: rules that block items matching them from passing this node.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.allow_lis: Open allow filters: rules that whitelist items; when this list is in effect, only matching items may pass.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.opaque_re: Normal rendering with transit visuals on ducts.
Opaque skin and hidden transit for this duct network (server; all players).
Opaque skin and hidden transit on all ducts you see (client only).
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.eligibili: This node can receive inserts from the network and can be used as a donor by Retrieving nodes.
This node can receive inserts from the network, but will NOT be used as a donor by Retrieving nodes.
This node will NOT receive inserts from the network, but can be used as a donor by Retrieving nodes.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.routing.t: Routing modes are split between this hybrid node’s two sub-modes; use the Routing control on the sub-page where it is shown.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.mode.tool: Current mode: default. This node accepts inserts from the network; deny/allow lists are ignored and all non-empty items may pass.
Current mode: extraction. Pulls items from the attached inventory and sends them into the duct network (respects routing when active).
Current mode: filtering insertion. Items inserted into the network through this face are checked against deny/allow lists.

Current mode: hybrid extraction + filtering. Pulls items from the attached inventory into the duct network, and filters incoming inserts using the Filter page lists. Routing matches extraction on both Extractor and Filter pages; Self Feed is available.
Current mode: retrieving. Pulls items from the duct network into the attached inventory (respects routing when active).

Current mode: hybrid retrieving + extraction. Pulls items from the duct network into the attached inventory, and also extracts from the attached inventory into the network. Configure routing on the Retriever page; it applies to both behaviors.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.routing.t: Current routing: try destinations nearest along the path first when pushing or pulling stacks.
Current routing: try farther destinations along the path first.
Current routing: bias toward mid-distance destinations first.
Current routing: rotate between destinations so each gets a turn.
Current routing: choose a random valid destination each time.
You can't set routing in this mode.
Routing is locked in hybrid modes.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.filters.t: You can't set filters in this mode.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.modify_bu: Configure per-face extract and insert buffer size limits (0 = AUTO).
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.energy_fi: Energy filters are not available yet.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.energy_bu: Buffer size limit in FE. AUTO uses the node default capacity.
Decrease buffer limit: steps 100, Ctrl or Alt+1000, Shift+10000.
Increase buffer limit: steps 100, Ctrl or Alt+1000, Shift+10000.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.hybrid.ex: Configure filters for the extractor behavior of this hybrid node.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.hybrid.re: Configure filters for the retriever behavior of this hybrid node.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.hybrid.fi: Configure filters used when this hybrid node filters incoming inserts.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.hybrid.se: When ON this node can route items into itself.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.redstone_: Always active. Neighbor redstone is ignored.
Active only when this face is unpowered.
Active only when this face is powered.
Never active. Transport on this face stays off.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.list_logi: Deny blocks Allow: if an item matches deny, it is blocked even when allow matches.
Allow bypasses deny: if an item matches allow, deny rules do not block it.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.amount.mi: Decrease priority: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+10, Shift+100.
Decrease quantity: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64. Use 0 / M for min and max.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.amount.pl: Increase priority: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+10, Shift+100.
Increase quantity: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64. Logical batch can exceed one stack; delivery splits per inventory rules. Use 1 / M for min and max.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.filters.r: Reorder filters to optimize them slightly
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.filters.c: Filters on this list that share a letter are concatenated.
Every filter in the group must match (AND).
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.filters.a: Save this filter line to the node and server; stay in advanced filtering.
gui.another_dynamics.settings_copier.fil: Cycle list type: None, Item, Fluid, Gas
Cycle list type: None, Item, Fluid
Choose a filter type (Item, Fluid, or Gas) before editing entries
Choose a filter type (Item or Fluid) before editing entries
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.filters.a: Insert &anything_else: matches everything else after more specific filters (reorder puts it last among filled lines).
item.another_dynamics.duct.opaque.desc.0: Global opaque (client) hides transit on all ducts you see; network opaque (server) applies to one connected duct network.
item.another_dynamics.duct.opaque.desc.1: If transit is visible and you experience lag, enable global opaque from any duct node.
item.another_dynamics.duct.opaque.desc.2: Open a duct node and click Opaque to cycle Off, Network, and All.
another_dynamics.project_duct.convert.pa: Converted %1$s of %2$s project ducts (not enough definitive ducts)
another_dynamics.project_duct.convert.li: Converted %1$s project ducts (max %2$s per action — click again)
another_dynamics.project_duct.convert.jo: Converted %1$s project ducts (job max %2$s — click again for more)
another_dynamics.project_duct.convert.in: Project duct conversion already in progress
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.allow_cap: Max matching items allowed in attached storage for this allow line (empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Max matching items allowed at the bound destination for this extractor allow line (requires destination; empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Bind a destination to edit Insert Limit for this extractor line.
Minimum matching items to leave when extracting or retrieving (empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Max matching fluid (mB) allowed in attached storage for this allow line (empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Max matching fluid (mB) allowed at the bound destination for this extractor allow line (requires destination; empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Minimum matching fluid (mB) to leave when extracting or retrieving (empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Max matching gas (Mekanism units) allowed in attached storage for this allow line (empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Max matching gas allowed at the bound destination for this extractor allow line (requires destination; empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Minimum matching gas (Mekanism units) to leave when extracting or retrieving (empty or ∞ = unlimited).
Decrease limit: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64.
Decrease keep: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64.
Increase limit: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64.
Increase keep: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.advanced_: Edit Limit (filter bank) or Keep (extractor/retriever) for this allow line: max items in storage or minimum to leave when extracting.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.channel_l: Channel letter is set inside each part of this node. Open Item, Fluid, Gas, or another lane below.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.transport: Transport enabled — open this lane from the hub
Transport disabled — lane entry is inactive
another_dynamics.duct_replace.unknown_ty: Cannot replace: the target duct type is unknown.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.incompatib: Cannot replace: the new duct does not support all transport types of the installed one.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.module_slo: Cannot replace: installed modules would not fit in the new duct's module slots.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.filter_slo: Cannot replace: active filters would be lost because the new duct has fewer filter slots.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.arm_projec: Shift again on this duct within 3s to convert connected project ducts.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.arm_defini: Shift again on this duct within 3s to upgrade all compatible ducts in the network.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.no_project: No connected project ducts to convert.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.no_compati: No other compatible ducts to replace in this network.
another_dynamics.duct_replace.job_cap: Replaced %1$s ducts (job max %2$s — click again for more)
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.remote_no: No remote node bound (applies to all counterparties).
Click with Remote Node Selector or external Filter Destination Tool (cursor only).
Click to bypass channel matching for this bound destination.
Left-click: next face. Right-click: previous face (N/S/E/W/U/D).
Any counterparty (*). Bind a destination with the slot to pick a face.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.advanced_: Bind a remote duct face to this deny line.
another_dynamics.stall_clear.arm_warning: Buffered fluid/gas: use a tank or bucket to extract, or empty both hands and shift-click again within 5s to destroy.
another_dynamics.stall_clear.incompatibl: Held item cannot receive stalled fluid or gas.
another_dynamics.stall_clear.container_f: Container is full or does not match the stalled fluid or gas.
gui.another_dynamics.general_filter_text: Matches any remaining item not caught by earlier lines.
Specific filters first; &anything_else sorts after them.
Good as default dest/cap after specials.
gui.another_dynamics.fluid_filter_text.a: Matches any remaining fluid not caught by earlier lines.
Specific filters first; &anything_else sorts after them.
Good as default dest/cap after specials.
gui.another_dynamics.gas_filter_text.any: Matches any remaining gas not caught by earlier lines.
Specific filters first; &anything_else sorts after them.
Good as default dest/cap after specials.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.s: ON: accept only the first incomplete step per list (safe with buffered ducts). OFF: accept future matching steps in parallel (faster, can jam buffered ducts).
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.r: Reorder steps by filter weight (-/#/@ same order; then & ?).
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.d: Empty the input buffer into your inventory. Overflow drops on the ground. Fluids/gas are discarded.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.i: To activate it, click the D button.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.e: Set some tasks on the sequence to activate it.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.c: Convert ghost/typed item to fluid or gas filter.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.t: Cycle step type: Item, Fluid, Gas.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.c: Copy all Sequence Lists into the Settings Copier.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.p: Paste Sequence Lists from the Settings Copier.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.c: Copy this Sequence List into the Settings Copier.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.p: Paste onto this Sequence List from the Settings Copier.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.g: Always works. Neighbor redstone is ignored.
Works only when the machine is unpowered.
Works only when the machine is powered.
Like a comparator on the front destination: when it holds any items, fluids, or chemicals, intake and staging turn off.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.v: Operators: | OR,  space AND (same as duct filters)
Note: &anything_else is not allowed in sequential steps.
Same filter syntax as duct fluid filters.
Use Convert with a filled bucket/tank to fill the filter.
Tag matching when supported by Mekanism filters.
Use Convert with a chemical container when Mekanism is loaded.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.d: Apply the delay draft (minutes, seconds, and ticks).
Discard the draft and reload the delay from the machine.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.l: Does not emit a ready signal for this Sequence List.
Emits redstone while this Sequence List is not ready (not fully gathered in the output).
Emits redstone while this Sequence List is ready (fully gathered in the output).
Emits a short redstone pulse when this Sequence List becomes ready.
gui.another_dynamics.sequential_buffer.c: Use C / P below to copy or paste Sequence Lists
item.another_dynamics.bulky_wrench.toolt: Disconnects duct faces and nodes without breaking the duct.
item.another_dynamics.duct.tooltip.summa: Duct that moves resources between connected inventories.
item.another_dynamics.project_duct.toolt: Scaffold duct for mass placement; Shift+duct item converts the network.
Collects listed amounts in order, then releases the batch.
Extends a machine's inventory and capability faces outward.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.amount.fi: Insertion priority: higher values are preferred when multiple insert faces compete.
Quantity moved per extract/retrieve shipment (one stack at most is delivered per inventory transfer).
How many extract/retrieve shipments to schedule in sequence each rate tick. Each step re-routes independently.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.amount.mi: Decrease sequential stacks: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.amount.pl: Increase sequential stacks: steps 1, Ctrl or Alt+8, Shift+64.
gui.another_dynamics.duct_node.amount.lo: Use a Duct or Module that supports this feature.
Use a Duct or Module that transports a greater quantity.
